QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_24

question.text: A Cat III AIF must appoint a custodian registered with SEBI for:

answer.text: Safekeeping of the securities/goods of the fund

explanation.text: The Logic: A Cat III AIF must appoint a custodian registered with SEBI for SAFEKEEPING of securities/goods of the fund. Fund administration, NAV computation and KYC may be outsourced separately; the custodian mandate is safekeeping. The Trap: Each of options A, B and D describes a valid service-provider role — but the custodian mandate is specifically safekeeping. Note: The workbook fixes the SEBI-registered custodian/safekeeping requirement; custodian-platform pre-trade compliance commentary is not part of the syllabus.
